elements_selected.content: Reviewer counted 36 `<h1>` elements in the memo-index DOM, breaking the heading outline for screen readers. Root cause: the transclusion preview rendered into `.tc-excerpt` at src/web/build.rs:1023 and src/web/routes.rs:720 embeds the target page's markdown, whose own `# Title` becomes an `<h1>` inside every chip. Demote headings in transclusion previews (h1→h3, h2→h4, etc.) — either strip them in the preview builder or apply a heading-shift pass when rendering excerpts. The chip anchor itself already uses `<a class="tc-title">` (not `<h1>`), so the fix is in the preview body, not the card shell.
